instruction: Build the missing parts they seem intuitive
scope: Derive shared live tags from Observer and Judge outcomes, with exact graph checks on Strict Ask and Advanced inspection presentation.
Atomically reuse current strict versions, link each new graph version to its predecessor, expose scope history, and verify active route metadata before using candidate locators.
validation: Passed 72 focused native checks covering concurrent graph writes, retired routes, mismatches, history, Spot and existing answers.
Matched all 22 historical native contracts and all 48 Scout graph passes against ordinary Strict Ask on the same frozen inputs.
limitations: Live synchronization is local to an ask or inspection scope. Ledger and SQLite graph storage have separate transactions.
Scout prose coverage remains a separate research result. Graph flags and candidates carry no proof authority.
Full local archive extraction exceeds available storage. Use the CI archive gate for the complete release candidate.
next_steps: Use the retained Scout obligations to build and evaluate a bounded native recommendation comparison.
